name: Vancouver Coastal Health North Shore Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at Lions Gate Hospital, health clinics, care homes and community programs. You might work at the front desk, show people the way, visit with patients, help a clinic or help at events.
who_can_apply: The page says its volunteers are over 16 years old. You need to be grown up, on time and good at talking with people.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Volunteers can get reference letters and recognition.
duration: 2 to 3 hours a week for at least 6 months
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply online any time.
how_to_apply: Fill in the North Shore form online. It takes 4 to 8 weeks. VCH runs a record check. Then you have an interview, reference checks and training.
notes: North Shore Volunteer Resources: (604) 984-5929, nsvolunteer@vch.ca. VCH's Vancouver program (VGH, UBC Hospital, G.F. Strong) does not state a minimum age on its pages, so ask vanvolunteer@vch.ca before applying there.
